name: football-player-position
description:
Multi-class classification dataset with the goal to predict players positions based on features of the player like height, shots per match, ingame minutes per match, and others.

The full list of features:
- Age
- Height
- Matches
- Minutes/Match
- Goals/Match
- Assists/Match
- Yellow Cards/Match
- Red Cards/Match
- Shots/Match
- Pass Success Rate/Match
- Aerials Won/Match


The target variables are:
- Defender
- Forward
- Goalkeeper
- Midfielder
creator: Stefan Heid
citation: MSL: Multi-class Scoring Lists for Interpretable Incremental Decision-Making
